items.title: How many candidate solutions does asking "why" unlock — and when does it go too far?
items.description: Starting from Mara's literal request ("a CSV export button"), each additional "why" moves the statement away from one requested tool and toward the real need. At 0 whys the statement is basically "build CSV." Around 3 whys it becomes "notice a worsening trend in time to act," which can be checked against several possible fixes: CSV, chart, alert, or email. Around 6 whys it may become too broad, like "feel in control," which is true but no longer useful for deciding what to build.
items.compute: const depth = params.whysDepth; const solutionOptions = Math.round(1 + 3 * (1 - Math.exp(-depth / 2))); let usefulness; if (depth <= 4) { usefulness = 40 + depth * 15; } else { usefulness = 100 - (depth - 4) * 25; } usefulness = Math.max(5, Math.min(100, Math.round(usefulness))); return { solutionOptions, usefulness };
